value.rationale: The exact count of distinct modal observations under arbitrary nesting is a natural expressivity invariant for a fixed finite temporal horizon in newly defined many-logic database temporal semantics. It gives a complete structural normal form, a quadratic-versus-unbounded-syntax collapse, and a constructive 2n-1 nesting-length bound, uniformly across nontrivial complete lattices; not an arbitrary parameter slice.
